name: dondlinger-digital-database-mcp
description: Production WebMCP Server for Dondlinger Digital Database & General Contracting Suite. Exposes machine-callable contractor tools, 15 sovereign Blazor WASM/PWA applications, concrete volume calculation engines, and ZLA technical specifications to autonomous agents.

tools.name: get_blazor_app_directory
tools.description: Retrieves the complete catalog of all 15 sovereign Blazor WebAssembly and Zero-Liability Progressive Web Applications with direct access URLs, target audiences, and capability summaries.

tools.name: calculate_concrete_volume
tools.description: Calculates required concrete cubic yards for slabs, footings, walls, and columns with safety margin waste factors (PourReady Engine).

width_feet.description: Width in feet (or diameter if column)

tools.name: get_contractor_info
tools.description: Retrieves official business identity, Wisconsin DSPS dwelling contractor licensure, insurance status, and primary service area coordinates.

tools.name: get_service_catalog
tools.description: Retrieves full catalog of residential construction capabilities including doors, replacement windows, siding/soffit/fascia, architectural roofing, shop cabinetry, and acoustical drop ceilings.

tools.name: submit_lead_intake
tools.description: Submits a prospective construction project or quote request directly to the Dondlinger GC intake system.

service.description: Requested trade (doors, windows, siding, roofing, cabinetry, ceilings, or custom)

notes.description: Project scope, dimensions, or specific requirements

address.description: Jobsite street address or city in Wisconsin

tools.name: query_zla_specs
tools.description: Queries the Zero-Liability Architecture (ZLA) software specification, offline-first WebAssembly PWA parameters, and cryptographic milestone logging.

component.description: The specific software suite module to query
